description: Ask Keryx — an autonomous research agent that buys paid sources under a budget, answers with inline citations, and pays each cited creator in USDC on Arc. Default deep-mode price is 0.05 USDC service fee + 0.05 USDC creator budget; the POST body sets the exact price. Paid from your own funded Arc Testnet wallet (eip155:5042002; run keryx_wallet_status first). Public research may send your question to Keryx's search provider. The source USDC budget is separate from model and search operating costs. New hosted runs are attributed to the verified paying wallet through agent-to-agent ingress; editable client metadata does not prove stdio identity or grant additional rights. Use when you want a grounded, source-cited answer AND the creators paid for their work. For title, ordered authors, year, journal, DOI or exact arXiv version without reading paper findings, use free paper_lookup with an exact identifier instead.

budget.description: Optional prepaid creator-spend cap in USDC (default 0.05); added to the deep-mode service fee.

language.description: Language of generated labels only. Does not change the paid body/hash, original question or answer. Defaults to verified completed-answer language when available; unknown stays unknown, and a differing override is disclosed.

mode.description: Interactive review mode is unavailable on stdio.

question.description: The research question to ask Keryx (3–2000 characters after trimming).

reviewFirst.description: Review-first requires the authenticated live browser; this adapter refuses true.
